bio: Situated in the heart of the picturesque Hertfordshire landscape on Tewinbury Farm, The Cowshed is named after it's original purpose: the farm's cow shed. These days, it is a comfortable and contemporary space to enjoy a decadent Afternoon Tea.  Blending the original features of the building with modern interiors, The Cowshed is a beautiful space to enjoy tea-time treats with the family. The décor is playfully accented with subtle cow-patterned furniture and lighting.  Their traditional Afternoon Tea menu features a range of finger sandwiches and savouries that can be enjoyed before delicious sweet delights such as scones and cakes. Everybody deserves cake, so Tewinbury Farm have created a Free From menu, full of sumptuous Egg Free, Gluten Free, Dairy Free & Nut Free treats.  The Cowshed at Tewinbury Farm Hotel is located just a short drive away from Welwyn North & Hertford North train stations.
